title: Surcharge Rights and Financial Protection Recorded Against the Vacation Package Products
content:
The operator liaison office records, for each of Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products, whether a fuel or currency surcharge may be added after booking, the share of the package price a surcharge must exceed before the party may cancel without penalty, the notice the party must be given, and whether the package carries financial protection against the failure of a supplier.

| Product | Surcharge may be added after booking | Surcharge threshold, as a share of the package price | Notice before departure, in calendar days | Financial protection against supplier failure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | yes | 8 per cent | 30 | carried |
| Flex Bundle Package | yes | 8 per cent | 30 | carried |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | yes | 8 per cent | 30 | carried |
| Escorted Tour Package | yes | 10 per cent | 45 | carried |
| Ocean Cruise Package | yes | 10 per cent | 60 | carried |
| Luxury Collection Package | no | 0 per cent | 0 | carried |

## Reading the threshold and notice columns

The threshold and the notice are recorded together and are read together: a product recording a threshold of 8 per cent and a notice of 30 calendar days, as the first three products in the range do, records both figures against the same surcharge right. The Luxury Collection Package records no surcharge right, and its threshold and notice figures stand at 0 per cent and 0 calendar days accordingly. Financial protection against the failure of a supplier is recorded as carried on every product in the range without exception.
